lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region. Spot size increases and density decreases moving from the anterior to the mid-section of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal arrangement of blobs, forming a grid-like matrix where blobs serve as focal nodes within the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.
